interface.name: withered-banner.html partial
interface.signature: {{ partial "withered-banner.html" . }} — input: page context (.). Reads: .Params.growth_stage, .Params.withered_date, .Params.withered_reason, .Params.replacement_url, .RelPermalink. Output: aside.withered-banner.notification.is-warning element OR nothing (when growth_stage != "withered").
interface.notes: Uses standard partial pattern (not return) — emits HTML directly into the calling template's flow. Caller passes the page (.) so partial can read frontmatter and resolve RelPermalink for the dismiss key.

interface.name: withered-banner.js dismiss handler
interface.signature: (function() { /* DOM-ready via defer-loaded bundle. Selects .withered-banner[data-banner-key]; reads sessionStorage[key]; on dismiss click sets key=1 and hides banner via banner.hidden=true. try/catch around sessionStorage access. */ })()
interface.notes: Storage key contract: withered-banner-dismissed:{{ .RelPermalink }} — written by the partial as data-banner-key attribute, read+written by the script. Single banner per page (querySelector, not querySelectorAll).

interface.name: frontmatter schema fields
interface.signature: withered_date: { type: "string", format: "date" } — required when growth_stage=="withered" (via if/then). withered_reason: { type: "string", maxLength: 280 } — optional. replacement_url: { type: "string", format: "uri-reference" } — optional. if: properties.growth_stage.const=="withered" then required:[withered_date].
interface.notes: JSON Schema draft-07 supports if/then conditional-required (Story 1.1 chose draft-07 for this reason). Validation runs in the git pre-commit hook AND the Hugo build-time partial.

interface.name: build-time validation contract
interface.signature: {{ if and (eq .Params.growth_stage "withered") (not .Params.withered_date) }}{{ errorf "%s: growth_stage=\"withered\" requires withered_date" .File.Path }}{{ end }}
interface.notes: Match existing error-message style from Story 1.1 (single line, includes .File.Path, names the missing field). Extends — does not replace — the enum check from 1.1.

interface.name: footer JS bundle composition
interface.notes: Append $witheredBanner := resources.Get "js/withered-banner.js" to the slice. Bundle is loaded async defer — DOM-ready timing implicit; no $(document).ready or DOMContentLoaded listener needed.
